notes.title: The Otterman Empire: Creative mode update
notes.notes:
Welcome to The Otterman Empire: Creative mode update! 

We are excited to announce that our action-packed multiplayer party game, The Otterman Empire, which launched on July 2nd 2020 on Steam, Nintendo Switch and Xbox has now got it's own creative mode! 


[previewyoutube=_0eIxNDcM7U;full][/previewyoutube]


Create your own custom arenas for you and your friends! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/c9c02acb05be3a174e5fc755e00f1e8e561dc3c5.png

Battle it out across otterspace, now with your own custom levels and game modes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/6d4d8a27b6ab8825f76a83ae57a603b07f1202fa.png

Welcome the Spy to the arena!

notes.title: THE OTTERMAN EMPIRE: ONLINE UPDATE .... ONE YEAR ON
notes.notes:
PLAY WITH UP TO 16 OTTERS ONLINE 

Yes we listened, launching a local only game during a pandemic was not the best circumstances! But after a year of development, we are excited to get everyone playing online! 

Host your own games, open it up or keep it between your friends, customise your characters and customise your match then take to the skies! 

There will be a bug or two, so please bare with us as we work to iron out the kinks! 

[previewyoutube=MxQFwhZdC-s;full][/previewyoutube]

WELCOMING TO THE ARENA, ROBOTTER!

He is fast, he is nimble and he's made of metal (We think) 

Armed with the baddest laser beam in otter space, Robotter blasts his way onto the scene with a whole host of new skins! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/a8da5c6a75cf2c6852048fb671841593a52a36a7.png

A WORD FROM OUR TEAM

Thank you for your on-going support. We know it has been a tough year for everyone and we have definitely felt it! 

Last year, we couldn't have asked for a better response but we knew we had more to give! We have been working incredibly hard to get online up and running, not to mention a creative mode and new characters! So we hope you enjoy a taste of what's to come in 2021 from The Otterman Empire.

See you in otterspace,

Kieran and the Tri-Heart Interactive team.

 x 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/21c6cd9d2854bc63bb6e7e1bf575f0337a8fcd2b.png

notes.title: Our new update is almost here.
notes.notes:
Our first quality of life update has been submitted!

As you all know we've been hard at work from our COVID bunkers working on getting our first quality of life update fixing and improving on a large count of improvements and issues brought to us by the community from launch and as of last week we have submitted our first official patch to the platform holders for review and are awaiting confirmation once it goes live.

As you know this update has taken its time as we have wanted to take our time in making sure that we got this process right, this is our first time as developers creating and uploading an update to all three platforms before and we are still learning a lot and have appreciated how patient you have been with us through this learning curve for us as a studio.

We will be releasing a full breakdown of what is going into the update once it is live on all platform's for you all and can't wait to share the future content we are working on in the background for you guys!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/b7892a0f447e556bd35adb9e1ec49bdd69dcb47f.jpg

Let us hear your thoughts!

Reviews help us so much with visibility on platforms and gaining valuable feedback that can be taken into further development and if you have time we would greatly appreciate it if you could take a moment to leave one for us <3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/d16a5bc9fd1ff2c908a58f0c52aae932fb8e1180.png

notes.title: Development Update 28/08/2020 - What have we been up to?
notes.notes:
What have we been up to?

It's been over a month since we launched The Otterman Empire and we have been listening to all your feedback, reviews, streams, Tweets and more and have been hard at work from our COVID bunkers working as a team on new content and updates that is coming for the game.

As you may have been seeing from our social media, Discrord and other social channels that we have been working on an update for all three platforms improving and adding features highlighted by the community.

We've been listening to everything you have to say and whilst we're keeping it mostly hush hush here are some of the things you can expect:

. Improved graphic sliders

. Improvement to our Nintendo Switch visuals 

. Adding the sprint function to the tutorial section of the game

There's ton more than just that being added to our multi platform update and we will put out an official breakdown of everything in the update once we are ready to go live with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/ad47201e39d59da106e51bdbb471df32da608250.png

But WAIT! There's more....

That's not all we've been up to however we have more content in development that we can't wait to show you, we have new characters and maps on the way as well as a load of brand new single player and local multiplayer content.

Without spoiling too much we're working on a brand new set of trials and gameplay content that we've already made some significant progress on that will make both playing solo and with your friends a real game changer, and we can't wait to show you what's in store for The Otterman Empire and the future of Otter Space.

Development Update 13/07/2020

Hey otter gang! Hope everyone had an amazing weekend, TH here bringing you all the latest updates from what we are working on from our bunkers at the moment for The Otterman Empire and what we have planned this week.

Dan the Man (lead programmer):

Dan is working on the AI profiling and pathways of a new enemy type we will be adding into The Otterman Empire, we have been listening to your feedback on wanting to see a better enemy variety within the single-player mode of The Otterman Empire and we have been working on three new enemy types already, we have been doing around the clock playtesting for these enemy types getting their pathfinding and profiling fine-tune for when they can be added to the main game for all you lovely otters to blast with your water weapons.

Additionally, Dan is also working on more localisation stuff for some new words that will be being added into the game which is a long process so he will be tackling that later this week.

Chris the Dis (lead artist):

Chris has been working on the character models for our new AI types that will be being added into The Otterman Empire with our new enemy all I can say is this much it's an enemy type Simran and Chris have wanted to add into the game for a long while and frankly it's so stupid it's amazing (ten points to the otter who gets the reference when they see it)

Additionally, he is also working on some art updates for the Nintendo Switch port of the game to be able to get the game to look more aesthetically pleasing without causing any issues for the Switch version of the game.

notes.title: The Otterman Empire: Steam update 001: Steam functionality update
notes.notes:
Hello Otters!

Thanks for your feedback and support. We're always listening. As always, please feel free to join us on our social channels or Discord if you have any questions about the game!


ADDED

. New Jetpack Input 

From players feedback we have added a new input for Jump and Jetpack - this is on the left trigger - we have not removed the old mapping so not to confuse players who are already used to the mapping for Jumping and Jetpacking.


Improved Keyboard Support

Player feedback suggested the need for improved keyboard support. The input icons will now show the appropriate icons when using either keyboard or controller.


FIXES

Bug Fix

Bug fixed that required you to click on the game window to have input for other controllers to join the game - you can now boot the game up, press the Join button on controllers 2 - 4 and they will join the game


Controller swap fix

Bug where the controllers would swap, if the keyboard was used first


Keyboard fix

Now when keyboard is used then the controller, controller 1 will be for player 1


Steam VR fix

Steam VR plug-in issue has now been resolved - This will stop The Otterman Empire from launching in Steam VR


Steam Controller fix

Steam controller plug-in has now been enabled allowing for the use of the Steam controller for the game


Start Menu Bug (Versus) 

Versus mode: When Paused during a round, selecting "Play" to restart the game didn't unpause the game


Controller Disconnect

The game freezes when the controller is unplugged, causing the music to continuing playing while there is no input


Video walkthrough 

For a full break down of our first Steam patch our creative director, Kieran Rogers will walk you through on our official Steam patch video down below.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE!! JULY 2ND
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=4jiN2lxN92I;full][/previewyoutube]After 3 years of countless hours of development, 2 roof collapsed studios, and a global pandemic we are happy to officially announce that as of July 2nd The Otterman Empire will be coming to Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and Steam.

The whole Tri-Heart Interactive team is so happy to finally be bringing split-screen and the game we’ve built alongside our community into the big wide world.

We wanted to take a moment to thank the whole Otterman community for the constant support you have shown us as a team over the past 3 years, you have been one of the bright lights in what was some dark tunnels as we pushed to bring split-screen madness to these three platforms from kind words, fan art, feedback and so much more, you have all been truly amazing and we’re so glad to be able to repay that kindness by bringing Otter Space to Switch, Xbox and Steam during these crazy times.

Big love to all our friends, peers in the games industry and family who have supported our long journey to reach this point, we can’t wait for you all to finally play this big labour of love.

Big thank you again, everyone, your support has meant the world to us.

You can now wishlist on The Otterman Empire on Steam, and pre-order on Nintendo Switch and Xbox One and every single one helps us out so much.

Watch this space guys there's still some time before the launch day and we've got more updates in-coming and we can't wait to show you what's coming.

notes.title: The Otterman Empire News Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/9f2e1b8d9d42aa8ef3f314f6fc0c4a6dea5e93e2.jpg

Hey everyone Simran Whitham one of the directors and community manager here at Tri-Heart Interactive I was just to give you all an update on what has happened over the last few months and where things currently stand with the team.

Around the beginning of the quarantine within the United Kingdom, we began exiting final additions and development on Otterman and began entering the polishing and QA stages of the project where we basically look at what things within the single-player mode and co-op modes could be tweaked, and improved upon and then constant testing of the PC, Xbox and Switch builds of the game tweaking and improving on all the content that would be within the launched product of the game before submitting to Steam and Xbox/Nintendo LOT check.

LOT check is a process in which developers must submit their games to a platform holder and then they review it and once you pass the checks you are then free to launch the game on the platform.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/a8659fe12a4996301099c67632b6d5b61266acb8.jpg

We had a few technical issues with this process around April time but are happy to say we passed this process which was a huge morale boost and hurdle for the team to get past this big monster.

Upon passing LOT check we then began doubling down on our optimisation, polishing and porting efforts which to avoid text of technical terms basically we were focusing our efforts on making the game as technically stable, performance-friendly, bug-free, and basically the best it can possibly be.

With the Nintendo Switch build of the game, much optimization has been conducted by our art lead Chris Taylor as he's been as the Switch has the least amount of processing power to be able to handle all the art textures and assets we had in the game such as shadows and lighting when compared to the Xbox or high/low-end PC's so a lot of Chris's efforts were spent making the Switch build of the game as stable as possible as removing art quality naturally results in less pretty looking visuals compared to other platforms which was something we simply could not accept so after weeks of work the lord himself Chris has managed to get TOE looking amazing on the platform.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/2340d27d1c3623919b9860a1ab6bb0999cf1e6ef.jpg

Our lead programmer Dan Williams has been leading the technical polish of the game both local and single-player mode finding those horrible little experience ruining annoyance bugs and kicking them out the game and polishing and tightening as much as he can.

Myself and our other community team members Dan Sheridan and Caroline Watson have been focused on outreach, press and building up our reach for the game for when our big announcements and release date come to help the game reach as many sales as possible so the team can eat food and have roof's over our heads.

And Kieran the creative director for TOE has been working on our business side of the studio, launch date ads we'll be running and communications with Nintendo's and Xbox's LOT check teams and a million others business related things. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36126687/b5b444a0daae825698f9d4c0823713d7652d822a.jpg

At the moment we're just now negotiating with the platform holders about some stuff regarding a special announcement we will be doing in the near future but just wanted to give you all an overview of what has been happening since the beginning of the pandemic.

Not much has changed for the team and we're still making amazing progress we're just not in the same room as each other but that hasn't stopped us ;)

[previewyoutube=Nn5BIX6_cTs;full][/previewyoutube]
